_doc: Presentation only (src/render/hero.js). How the hero carries each weapon type when not attacking, and the arc a melee swing follows. Positions are the right palm in the hero's body space (x left, y up, z forward, metres); dir is where the weapon's long axis points (blade or shaft tip). two = the left hand also holds it (used when nothing is in the left hand), with grip = where along the weapon the left palm goes (metres from the right palm, + toward the head). one = the carry with a shield or second weapon in the left hand; dual (optional) = the carry with a second weapon there, whose left = that hand's palm, blade direction and flat (hero.js solveOffhand). presets keeps carries for other bodies. A carry may have run (hero.js runCarry): its hand, dir and up while moving (left for a dual carry), release to let a two-hand grip go, and lean: bone offsets and a drop added on the run; or arms: the carrying arm's own channels (armR/elbowR, with armL/elbowL for a dual carry; the wrist straight, no hand IK), socket: the weapon's turn in the fist (the weapon channel's x, rest 1.2; past pi/2 the blade leaves the little-finger side), roll: the blade turned about its length, reverse: the fist keeps its thumb toward the pommel (a blade dragged behind); all faded in by the walk/run blend. castHold keeps the weapon's carry angle (not the palm position) through spell actions, so a staff stays upright while the arm gestures. swing.radius is the right palm's distance from the body axis during a swing; actions.js swing keys give the angle (0 forward, + to the hero's left), blade elevation and palm height. stance names the idle body stance in stances (default relaxed): bone offsets (Euler XYZ radians, the same channels as actions.js) added to the standing pose and faded out as the hero walks; drop lowers the body (metres), shift moves it toward the hero's left (+) or right (-). keepGrip (the greatshield) keeps the left hand on the weapon through every action; a greatshield's dir runs from the right grip bar to the left one and up is its face.

presets._doc: Carries kept for other bodies. two_hand_feminine: a two-hand grip held across the body (KayKit 2H_Melee_Idle, stance two_hand_ready), chosen by the owner for a female hero; the male chibi keeps its own two-hand carries.
